outcome: Incidence of early postpartum voiding dysfunction (PPVD)
finding: Primiparae women who had a vaginal delivery were at higher risk of transient PPVD during their early postpartum period than those who delivered by elective caesarean section.
mod_finding: Within the vaginal delivery group, women who had a vaginal tear or epidural analgesia experienced a higher incidence of PPVD.
